title: Nexus RunResponse
description: Response for POST /v1/daemon/compute/run — result of a direct-lane compute invocation (V1.147 P0). On success (status "succeeded"), proposals are populated for review-then-accept. On failure (status "failed"), error provides the honest reason; World is unchanged and no Timeline events are created.

run_id.description: Unique run identifier (run_<uuid>) for subsequent Accept/Discard/detail operations.

status.description: Run outcome: succeeded (proposals available for review) or failed (error populated).

module_version.description: Version of the module at invocation time.

proposals.description: Module output proposals (state_delta, timeline_events, new_key_blocks, battle_report). Present only when status is "succeeded". World is not yet mutated — author must Accept or Discard.

error.description: Honest error detail when status is "failed" (sandbox limit, module trap, host error, etc. per route spec §4).

truncated.description: True when the proposals payload was truncated because the full response exceeded 1 MiB. Full output is always available via GET /runs/:id.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of run creation.
